cases.sentence: Злое и развратное ___ ищет знамения, но ему не будет дано никакого знамения, кроме знамения Ионы.
cases.explain: Поколение is the subject of ищет, so it stands in the nominative.

cases.sentence: Фарисеи и саддукеи просили, чтобы он показал им знамения с ___.
cases.explain: The preposition с (from) takes the genitive → неба.

cases.sentence: Симон Петр ответил, «Ты Христос, Сын Живого ___».
cases.explain: Сын кого (son of whom) is a possessive relationship, so the noun goes into the genitive → Бога.

cases.sentence: Иисус же, обернувшись, сказал ___, «Прочь от меня, сатана!»
cases.explain: сказал кому (said to whom) takes its indirect object in the dative → Петру.

cases.sentence: Тогда сын человеческий воздаст каждому по его ___.
cases.explain: The preposition по (according to) takes the dative → делам (dative plural).

cases.sentence: Тогда Петр отвел его в ___ и стал возражать.
cases.explain: в with a verb of motion (отвел в сторону — led aside) takes the accusative → сторону.

cases.sentence: Сын человеческий придет в славе своего отца, окруженный своими ___.
cases.explain: окруженный (surrounded by) takes the instrumental → ангелами.

cases.sentence: И на этой ___ я построю мою церковь, и врата ада не одолеют ее.
cases.explain: на marking location, not motion, takes the prepositional → скале.

reading.ru: Там Иисуса обступили фарисеи и саддукеи, которые, желая испытать его, просили, чтобы он показал им знамения с неба.
reading.question: What did the Pharisees and Sadducees ask Jesus for?
reading.explain: The Pharisees and Sadducees, testing Jesus, asked him to show them a sign from heaven.

reading.ru: Злое и развратное поколение ищет знамения, но ему не будет дано никакого знамения, кроме знамения Ионы.
reading.question: What sign did Jesus say this generation would receive?
options: No sign except the sign of Jonah
A sign written in the sky
reading.correct: No sign except the sign of Jonah
reading.explain: Jesus said no sign would be given to this generation except the sign of Jonah.

reading.ru: Переправляясь на другую сторону озера, ученики забыли взять с собой хлеба. Иисус же сказал им, «Смотрите, берегитесь за кваски фарисеев и саддукеев».
reading.question: What warning did Jesus give the disciples after they forgot to bring bread?
options: To beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees
To buy bread in the next town
To fast until they returned home
To share their bread with the crowd
reading.correct: To beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees
reading.explain: Jesus told the disciples to watch out for the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.

reading.ru: Симон Петр ответил, «Ты Христос, Сын Живого Бога».
reading.question: How did Peter answer when Jesus asked who they said he was?
options: You are the Christ, the Son of the living God
You are John the Baptist come again
You are a teacher sent from Rome
reading.correct: You are the Christ, the Son of the living God
reading.explain: Peter answered that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of the living God.

reading.ru: И я говорю тебе, ты, Петр, и на этой скале я построю мою церковь, и врата ада не одолеют ее».
reading.question: What did Jesus say he would build on 'this rock'?
options: His church, which the gates of Hades would not overcome
A monument to John the Baptist
reading.correct: His church, which the gates of Hades would not overcome
reading.explain: Jesus said he would build his church on this rock and the gates of Hades would not prevail against it.

reading.ru: Тогда Петр отвел его в сторону и стал возражать, «Да помилует тебя Бог! Пусть не случится с тобой этого, Господи!»
reading.question: How did Peter react when Jesus predicted his suffering and death?
options: He took Jesus aside and objected, saying this must never happen to him
He agreed it was necessary and said nothing
He asked to die in Jesus's place
reading.correct: He took Jesus aside and objected, saying this must never happen to him
reading.explain: Peter took Jesus aside and began to rebuke him, saying such a thing must never happen.

reading.ru: А кто потеряет свою жизнь ради меня, тот обретет ее.
reading.question: What did Jesus say about losing one's life for his sake?
options: Whoever loses his life for Jesus's sake will find it
Whoever loses his life will never recover it
Only the disciples could lose their lives for him
Losing one's life brings no reward
reading.correct: Whoever loses his life for Jesus's sake will find it
reading.explain: Jesus taught that whoever loses his life for his sake will find it.
